title: VueScan alternative headlines flat

change.control: Existing VueScan homepage headline and subhead.
change.variant: Test alternative headline-subhead combinations, including negative and nonnegative framing, without the later button changes.

significance.reported: Source reports a flat, non-significant result.

quote: Even after 36 days of running and tons of traffic through all variations, the result was flat and non-significant.
notes: Multi-arm headline experiment reported in aggregate; individual headline results are not duplicated. Source mentions a maximum trending 4–5% lift but not an exact single comparison, so lift is null. Separate subsequent button experiment is not included.
